change: Use LAPACKE dpotrf_work/dpotrs_work/dpotri_work, retaining scaling and rank guards; no sampler changes.

backend.BLAS_LAPACK: OpenBLAS 0.3.20 NO_LAPACKE DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Prescott SINGLE_THREADED

checks.scope: RapidGLM wrapper/engine instrumented; external LAPACK/BLAS uninstrumented
one public S1 NB response, 20729 observations

fit_comparison_metric: abs(new-old)/(1+abs(old)); compared with retained native outputs, not a fresh R run

benchmarks.current_compile_flags: -O3 -DNDEBUG -fopenmp; CMake Release; no architecture-specific optimization flags
benchmarks.interpretation: Both sessions retained. 64/128-predictor factorization and inversion improved on these synthetic inputs. Small-system timings vary and can regress. Four-predictor whole-fit timings are essentially unchanged. No end-to-end or clean-host speedup claim.

limitations: Acceptance thresholds remain provisional. Prior G3/G5 and other runbook failures are not reclassified.
No fresh full calibration or workflow performance qualification was attempted for this numerical backend change.
Benchmark fits use fixed NB theta and exclude setup; ML dispersion timing is not covered by that microbenchmark.
Shared host. Initial benchmark overlapped local validation/build work; final benchmark ran after our other checks completed, with external activity still possible.
Local shared LAPACKE initially failed to load its extracted transitive libtmglib dependency. Using the LAPACKE archive resolved this; final binaries link serial OpenBLAS dynamically.
An initial external-consumer data extraction selected the wrong matrix axis and was corrected to one feature across cells. The corrected S1 check passed.

thread_safety_followup.note: Historical observations above are retained. The original serial OpenBLAS build failed a deterministic concurrent-call regression. The local dependency was replaced with pthread OpenBLAS with one internal worker. Earlier small-panel thread checks did not establish backend safety; the extreme parallel boundary results should not be attributed solely to convergence logic. The independent stopping-rule mismatch remains unfixed.
